folders.addForProject: Add a folder to the whole project

reasons.folder_preset_taken: This project has this standard folder already.
reasons.folder_preset_stage: A standard folder is for the whole project.
reasons.folder_preset_name: A standard folder keeps its own name.
reasons.folder_locked_task_file: A file of a to-do cannot go in a locked folder.
reasons.folder_locked_cover: The cover of the project cannot be in a locked folder.
reasons.folder_locked_tracker: A file in a locked folder cannot go on the Tracker.
reasons.folder_lock_task_file: This folder holds a file of a to-do. Move the file out first.
reasons.folder_lock_cover: This folder holds the cover of the project. Change the cover first.
reasons.folder_locked_has_files: This folder is locked and holds files. Unlock the folder first.
reasons.file_locked: A file in a locked folder stays in its folder.
reasons.folder_locked: A locked folder cannot be deleted. Unlock it first.
reasons.folder_lock_tracker_file: A Tracker line names a file in this folder. Change the line first.

2026-10-23-138.title: Folders for the whole project
2026-10-23-138.body: Make a folder for the whole project, not for one stage. It shows above the stages in Files & Links. Press it to open it. Each client project has a Client documents folder.

2026-10-23-139.title: Locked folders
2026-10-23-139.body: A locked folder and its files show only to people who hold the Locked folders switch. Each client project has a locked Contract folder. Lock or unlock any folder from its menu.
